items.title: Labarbera interviewed by Monk Rowe, 2021
items.q: I’ve watched your interviews with a number of folks, including my brother Pat

ctx.x: John was interviewed via Zoom on July 13, 2021 by Monk Rowe, Director of the Fillius Jazz Archive.

My name is Monk Rowe for the Fillius Jazz Archive at Hamilton College. I’m very pleased to have John LaBarbera with me today. I’m going to introduce you as first a fourth trumpeter, composer/arranger, and I’m very glad to have you here because I love talking about composing and arranging.
Well thanks, Monk. I’ve watched your interviews with a number of folks, including my brother Pat, and you know, I really enjoy being a part of this. Really.

items.title: Labarbera interviewed by Monk Rowe, 2021
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] My name is Monk Rowe for the Fillius Jazz Archive... [INTERVIEWEE] Thank you, Monk, thanks for having me.

ctx.x: My name is Monk Rowe for the Fillius Jazz Archive, and I’m very pleased to have Pat LaBarbera with me this afternoon. And we are in two different countries but we’re doing the Zoom thing. Welcome, Pat.
Thank you, Monk, thanks for having me.

Yeah. I wanted to tell you that I have been, as a child mostly, through Mount Morris many times. We used to travel from Rochester down to the Southern Tier to visit relatives. And when I saw that, about where you’re from and your brothers, and I wondered if the Mount Morris Shopper, which was the local newspaper, did they ever do a story on your family band?
